purpose: Set the topic or establish a contrast.
keywords: Topic noun / phrase + は（pronounced わ）.
As for me, I am a student.
I drink tea, but I do not drink coffee.
Set a topic or identify a subject
formation: Topic noun / phrase + は（pronounced わ）.
restrictions: The topic need not be the grammatical subject.
mistake: Do not assume は and が can be exchanged without changing the information focus.
